## Checklist

- [ ] `swift build -c release` and `swift run CoreChecks` pass
- [ ] `python3 scripts/gen_registry.py --check` passes (if `registry/apps.json` changed)
- [ ] New bundle IDs have a public evidence link
- [ ] UI changes include before and after screenshots (`open build/MeetingMute.app --args --demo`)
